messages:
maria: quick check — trying to spin a small dedicated pool in eu-west1 for BrightByte; terraform apply fails with a quota error. Anyone seen this exact message before?

maria: error snippet:
```
Error: googleapi: Error 403: Quota 'GPUS_PER_REGION' exceeded for project 12345-abc on region europe-west1., quotaExceeded

  with module.dedicated.google_compute_region_instance_group_manager.pool[0],
  on modules/dedicated/main.tf line 82, in resource "google_compute_region_instance_group_manager" "pool":
  82: resource "google_compute_region_instance_group_manager" "pool" {
```

maria: we've requested extra GPUs via the console but vendor support says they didn't receive a quota increase request for our billing account. pinging @greg. :wave:

ivan: @maria — is this for a new billing account or the shared infra one? if new, CloudVendorX needs the billing ID attached before quota requests can route.

maria: shared infra billing (project under infra-ops). I checked IAM and billing link looks ok.

kevin: can you paste the terraform snippet you're using? maybe region-level quota vs zone-level thing.

maria: sure:
```hcl
resource "google_compute_region_instance_group_manager" "pool" {
  name               = "dedicated-brightbyte-pool"
  region             = "europe-west1"
  base_instance_name = "brightbyte-ded"
  version {
    instance_template = google_compute_instance_template.it.self_link
  }
  target_size = 2
}
```

julia: looks fine. are you requesting specific accelerator type in the instance template? e.g. nvidia-tesla-a100?

maria: yes a100 80GB. template has:
```
accelerators {
  type  = "nvidia-tesla-a100"
  count = 1
}
```

ivan: ok. CloudVendorX recently split GPU quotas across sub-accounts for partner fleets. our infra project might be on the older quota shard. if the portal increase wasn't applied to that shard it won't show as increased. @greg can confirm what they submitted.

greg (procurement): I filed the increase yesterday with ticket CVX-23419 and included project 12345-abc and billing acct IA-987. Support emailed back saying they raised compute quota but not GPU quota — they asked for the accelerator SKU name (they often need the exact SKU string).

maria: hmm. I used "nvidia-tesla-a100" in terraform. any idea what exact SKU they want?

greg (procurement): I'll forward the vendor message, but for CloudVendorX they usually want something like "A100-80GB" or internal SKU e.g. "GPU_A100_80GB_REG". I'll update the ticket.

vendor-bot: [CVX Support] Ticket CVX-23419 — pending: vendor awaiting accelerator SKU and region confirmation for quota increase. Last updated 2025-03-21 09:12 UTC.

kevin: while greg updates ticket, you can try a quick smoke by spinning a single VM in a-zone via console — if console blocks, it's definitely quota. if console succeeds but terraform fails, it's probably service-account scope or API enablement.

maria: tried console -> blocked with same quota message when selecting A100 in europe-west1-a. screenshot attached in ticket.

julia: ok that rules out SA. greg can we ask vendor to apply the increase to our infra shard and confirm the internal SKU? also ask them to whitelist project id 12345-abc explicitly.

greg (procurement): will do. sending updated message now: "Please apply GPU quota increase for GPU_A100_80GB_REG in europe-west1 to project 12345-abc (billing IA-987)." cc'ing our partner rep.

ivan: nice. FYI when they apply it can take ~30-60m to propagate. the quota monitor sometimes underreports until it's flattened. keep an eye on cloud console quotas page.

maria: thanks all. I'll hold the terraform apply until vendor confirms. quick ask: for future, is there an infra playbook to avoid this manual SKU lookup?

julia: short-term: add a tiny checklist in the pool onboarding doc — include exact internal SKU strings per vendor and a sample vendor request template. long-term: we should automate mapping from terraform accelerator.type -> vendor SKU in provisioning scripts.

maria: sweet — created a tiny PR: https://git.redwood/infrastructure/ops/merge-requests/442 — includes template. please review when you get a sec. :+1:

greg (procurement): update from vendor: they've applied GPU_A100_80GB_REG quota to project and increased regional quota to 5. propagation in progress, expect ~45 minutes.

vendor-bot: [CVX Support] Ticket CVX-23419 updated — quota increase applied to project 12345-abc.

maria: re-ran console after 50m — can now select A100 and create instance. re-running terraform apply now.

kevin: good luck. if terraform errors with 403 again, try adding explicit `quota_project` in provider block or re-create service account creds.

maria: terraform apply succeeded. pool created (target_size 2). marking done in ticket and closing wound. :tada:

julia: nice! can you paste the ticket closure message in the MR so we have the full runbook trace?

maria: done — updated MR with CVX-23419 closure and the vendor reply. thanks everyone.

ivan: great doc, thanks for grabbing it. :clap:
